print("Total:", total)

title: Lap times
description:
Ask how many laps were run. It must be from 1 to {{most}}: while it isn't, print "Try again" and ask again. Then read each lap time in seconds and print the total and the fastest, like:
Total: 190
Fastest: 58
solution:
laps = int(input("Laps (1-{{most}}): "))
while laps < 1 or laps > {{most}}:
    print("Try again")
    laps = int(input("Laps (1-{{most}}): "))
total = 0
fastest = 0
for lap in range(laps):
    t = int(input("Time: "))
    total = total + t
    if lap == 0 or t < fastest:
        fastest = t
print("Total:", total)
print("Fastest:", fastest)
hints: A while loop checks the number of laps; a for loop reads the times.
Use a while loop when you don't know how many tries it will take, and a for loop when you do.
The first time is the fastest so far.
